name: Werkstadt Zine Fest
description: An afternoon festival exploring Berlin's independent FLINTA* zine scene with zinemakers presenting their creations. The program includes a zine workshop by Sára titled 'Keep your flowers-Notes on Rage Across the City' and an open table hosted by Leo from 'Grandma Zone' where attendees can learn how zines are made, cut, fold, staple, and discuss. The event emphasizes community as practice rather than buzzword, with free entry and all sales proceeds going directly to artists.
